solution.title: Cisco ISE VPN + Intune Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit

products.name: Cisco ISE VPN + Intune Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: A structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for the Cisco Secure Client + ISE + Intune stack — isolate a failing cert, profile, EAP-TLS, or posture layer in minutes. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Find why the Cisco VPN + Intune handshake is failing — fast

When certificate VPN or ISE posture stops working, the failure hides across four layers — the Intune cert/profile, the Entra app, the EAP-TLS chain, and ISE authorization. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for the Cisco Secure Client + ISE + Intune stack so you isolate the failing layer in minutes instead of guessing — a self-guided troubleshooting playbook you keep and reuse.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the full Cisco-ISE-VPN + Intune signal path (cert issuance → profile apply → client connect → EAP-TLS → ISE posture/authorization) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (Intune + Graph read access, device logs, the Secure Client/ISE live-log vantage points, an Entra app for compliance) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a structured root-cause decision tree by symptom (no cert, cert but no chain, client won't connect, EAP-TLS fails, connected but denied by posture), each with the exact checks and the layer it isolates.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — end-to-end diagnostic collection, certificate + chain validation, compliance/enrollment state check, VPN client + profile state check, and a consolidated diagnostics report.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each pass/fail gate to the fix, plus Best Practices for repeatable triage and escalation to Cisco with the right evidence.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The failing layer of a Cisco VPN + ISE + Intune stack isolated in minutes — a structured playbook and scripts you keep and reuse on every incident.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CISEDIAG-Check-Compliance.ps1 — read the device compliance/enrollment state as ISE would read it (via Graph)
    • CISEDIAG-Check-VpnClient.ps1 — check the Cisco Secure Client / VPN client and profile state on this device
    • CISEDIAG-Collect.ps1 — end-to-end read-only diagnostic collection for the Cisco ISE VPN + Intune stack
    • CISEDIAG-Report.ps1 — consolidated cross-layer diagnostics report for the Cisco ISE VPN + Intune stack
    • CISEDIAG-Validate-Certificate.ps1 — validate the VPN client-authentication certificate and full chain on this device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
